policy: Passive numeric observations must not change native behavior. Missing raw data, dropped data without counters, and incomplete runs cannot pass readiness.
required_evidence: 10 minute passive realtime raw observation stream
four runtime-distinct actors, generation changes and increasing observation sequence
finite numeric features, declared units, availability and validity flags
hidden target current values absent, last known state explicitly aged
16 bounded local obstacle rays using native world collision
native event source and first delivered sample timestamps
bounded queues with explicit dropped counters
same-build paired observer on/off native trace parity and measured throughput
observer work measured on simulation thread including serialization
no graphics, audio or GPU device and unchanged production service states
limitations: Observation subscription is passive and does not acquire body control.
Action masks and can_decide are availability only until the shared stage 4 resolver exists.
Frame quantization and sample scheduling use game time; wall measurements are local to one engine process.
Native event delivery is bounded in simulation steps and does not claim a network or model response latency.
Service state snapshots are not ASR/TTS latency measurements.
